scope: engineering implementation/validation audit, not submission materials or complete protocol certification

requirements.requirement: FPGA RTL design, eLinx synthesis and post-synthesis functional simulation
requirements.scope: actual complete exported netlist and original vendor compatibility primitives

requirements.requirement: tx_data input and rx_data output carry VLID plus original application payload
requirements.scope: two-byte big-endian VLID and 1..1471 bytes; continuous-valid burst boundary

requirements.requirement: Independent A/B gigabit GMII MAC paths
requirements.scope: 125MHz 8-bit, two self-written MAC TX/RX paths, same-clock PHY profile

requirements.requirement: Ethernet/IPv4/UDP framing, VLID/SN and <=1518-byte Ethernet frame
requirements.scope: independent byte/FCS oracle; 1/64/512/1471 payload lengths

requirements.requirement: Reject malformed FCS/IP/UDP without delivering invalid application data
requirements.scope: valid/zero UDP checksum plus corrupted FCS/IP/UDP; rejected peer does not poison SN

requirements.requirement: Per-network and per-VL sequence integrity, wrap, missing/duplicate/old frame handling
requirements.scope: PSN +1/+2, invalid SN updates PSN, 255->1; SN0 is non-delivered reset control

requirements.requirement: A/B deduplication, skew and single-network failure/recovery
requirements.scope: first valid copy; delayed B, PHY fault, lost network; 5ms skew, delayed SN0 and 256 reset generations

requirements.requirement: Atomic buffering and scheduling without partial-message leakage
requirements.scope: 16 shared TX slots and 16 receive banks per network; malformed app messages rejected atomically

requirements.requirement: BAG shaping and service/business scheduling
requirements.source: Guide PDF p4 ARINC664P7; XAPP1130 p6-p9
requirements.scope: eight legal BAG values in real builder/MAC test; default integration profile 1ms; independent gate retained

requirements.requirement: >=100Mbps application payload injection, stable without loss/overflow/blocking
requirements.scope: 512x1471 bytes, 16 VL, 8000-cycle offered interval; redundancy counted once

requirements.requirement: Application-to-application single-frame worst observed latency below 2ms
requirements.scope: input first byte to output last byte (conservative); declared admissible load only

requirements.requirement: Same-VL, same-length latency range within tens of microseconds
requirements.scope: official gives no exact numeric threshold; 50us is an engineering check, not an official fixed limit

requirements.requirement: Minimum, maximum and at least two intermediate lengths; multi-VL concurrency
requirements.scope: 1,64,512,1471 payload bytes; variable lengths and sustained same-length window

requirements.requirement: Configure 128 TX VLs, application stimulus injection
requirements.scope: all 128 business VLs actually transmit; parameters configure contiguous VL range at elaboration

requirements.requirement: 4096 RX VL support
requirements.scope: every VL gets SN1 and SN2 on both real GMII networks: 8192 application deliveries

requirements.requirement: SNMP network management
requirements.scope: SNMPv1 GET/GETNEXT/SET profile; six system objects, v2c limited request extension; SET persistence through netlist

requirements.requirement: RTC synchronization with network time source
requirements.scope: Q32.32 timebase, four timestamp SNTP, negative/timeout unit tests, real network synchronization

requirements.requirement: Normal synthesis on supported eLinx device
requirements.scope: EQ6HL130/CSG484_H, no resource-score threshold

requirements.requirement: Self-written stimulus and independent verification
requirements.scope: full RTL scope plus same-version SNMP/RTC management netlist test; no force, no scaled BAG

requirements.requirement: ARINC664P7 communication functions required by the guide
requirements.scope: Declared-profile behaviors are tested, but no complete clause-by-clause protocol conformance audit exists. Formal certification is not stated as a contest requirement.

requirements.scope: module implemented/tested; complete new-wrapper loading session remains unverified
